play.started: The game is starting. The first start compiles the game's shaders and takes a few minutes.
play.exitedWithError: The game stopped with an error
play.exitCode: Exit code {{code}}: see the Log tab.

home.title: Hunt the night
home.subtitle: Bloodborne, running natively on Apple Silicon.
home.gameFolderHint: Your dump of Bloodborne (any region) with the 1.09 update merged in.
home.dlcMissingHint: This edition sells The Old Hunters as an add-on, which the port does not load yet.
home.firstStart: The first start compiles the game's shaders, so it takes a few minutes. Later starts are fast.
home.lastRunError: The game stopped with exit code {{code}}.

graphics.title: Graphics
graphics.subtitle: Shared with the in-game menu (F1 or L3 + R3).
graphics.outputResHint: The size of the image on screen. The upscaler fills it.
graphics.monitorHint: Where the game window and fullscreen open.
graphics.upscalingHint: The game renders below the output resolution and FSR reconstructs the image: the biggest performance lever on Apple Silicon.
graphics.objectMotionHint: Less ghosting on moving characters with FSR. Costs about 5 ms per frame on Apple GPUs.

controls.title: Controls
controls.subtitle: Bindings are stored in bbport.ini and apply when the game starts.
controls.controllerHint: The chosen one is used as soon as it is connected.
controls.noControllers: No controller connected. Connect one by USB or Bluetooth and refresh.
controls.press: Press a button or key… (Esc cancels)

game.title: Game
game.subtitle: Patches applied to the game when it starts.
game.systemLanguageHint: The PS4 system language the game sees.
game.effectsHint: Turn off what you don't like, or to gain a little performance.
game.debugCameraHint: Hold Cross and press L3 to cycle modes (keyboard: Space + Z).
game.debugMenuHint: Needs DbgFont14h.ccm and DbgFont14h.tpf in the game's dvdroot_ps4/font. Opens with the left touchpad or Tab.

mods.title: Mods
mods.subtitle: Loose-file mods, loaded in order: later ones override earlier ones. The game folder is never changed.
mods.folderHint: Each mod is a folder (with dvdroot_ps4/, or the game's folders such as chr/ directly).
mods.emptyHint: Put mod folders into the mods folder and refresh.

patches.title: Patches
patches.subtitle: Third-party patches in shadPS4's XML format, for game version 01.09.
patches.emptyHint: Put shadPS4-format XML patch files into the patches folder and refresh.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.subtitle: Options for troubleshooting and testing.
advanced.launcherLanguageHint: The in-game menu follows it (English or Russian).
advanced.readbacks: GPU data read by the CPU
advanced.liveResolutionHint: Change the output and preset without restarting, at a performance cost.
advanced.saveLog: Save the log and statistics to a file
advanced.saveLogHint: In the logs folder of the data folder.
advanced.crashDiagHint: Checks the game's heap and records writes into it. Slightly slower.
advanced.extraEnvHint: NAME=value pairs separated by spaces, passed to the game.
advanced.dataFolderHint: Settings, saves, the shader cache and logs.

log.title: Log
log.subtitle: The game's output from the last start.
log.emptyHint: Start the game to see its output here.

upscaler.fsr411Hint: FSR 4.1.1 neural upscaler running on Apple Metal
upscaler.fsr3Hint: Renders below the output and reconstructs it

drawPipe.autoHint: On with 8 or more CPU threads
